s1.title: Welcome to Skillentis
s1.body: Visualize the real evolution of any GitHub developer. We'll show you in 4 steps how to get the most out of it.

s2.title: Connect your GitHub
s2.body: Add your GitHub username in Settings to analyze your own profile in one click and unlock badges.

s3.title: Explore the leaderboard
s3.body: Discover the developers with the highest Codexa Index and check your position on the global ranking.

s4.title: Compare developers
s4.body: Pick two profiles and see their metrics and evolution side by side. Perfect for recruiters and tech teams.

s5.title: Share your evolution
s5.body: Generate your public Evolution Card and share it on LinkedIn, Twitter or anywhere. Your trajectory speaks for you.

problem.subtitle: Hiring still relies on snapshots. But real talent is visible in the trajectory.

resumes.title: Resumes lie
resumes.description: A CV shows what someone claims. GitHub shows what someone actually built — but nobody reads the history.

challenges.title: Coding challenges are snapshots
challenges.description: A 2-hour test measures performance under pressure, not years of consistent learning and growth.

scores.title: Scores create distrust
scores.description: “Why should I trust that score?” — Numbers without context feel arbitrary.

talent.title: Talent is trajectory
talent.description: The best signal of a great developer isn't what they know today — it's how fast they learn and evolve.

solution.subtitle: Skillentis transforms years of GitHub activity into a structured evolution record. Not a judgment — evidence.

features.subtitle: Skillentis analyzes public GitHub data to detect real signals of professional development.

timeline.title: Evolution Timeline
timeline.description: See how skills and practices evolved year over year through repository history.

growth.title: Growth Metrics
growth.description: Track consistency, architecture complexity, project scope, and collaboration patterns.

consistency.title: Consistency Signals
consistency.description: Detect contribution patterns and sustained development activity over time.

complexity.title: Repo Complexity
complexity.description: Analyze how repository architecture evolved from simple scripts to complex systems.

collaboration.title: Collaboration Patterns
collaboration.description: Understand teamwork signals through PRs, reviews, and multi-contributor projects.

codexa.title: Codexa Index
codexa.description: A summary metric based on years of repository evolution — not a snapshot judgment.

evolutionPreview.subtitle: Evolution is visible when you look at the trajectory.
